detail.longDescription: Any developers on here who are based in the U.S. and have commercial experience with encryption software, dealing with U.S. export controls? Trying to decide whether to self-classify with a license exemption, or apply directly with the U.S. Department of Commerce. I am seeking 5D992.c classification for mass-market, and not trying to spend even more money consulting an attorney over the matter. Any advice would be very much appreciated. 🔒👨🏻‍💻 # Dev # WebDev
